fact_pattern: A 19-year-old takes another person's motorcycle from outside a residence after secretly obtaining the keys. The owner discovers the vehicle missing.

legal_question: Which penal section defines and punishes this conduct?
expected_legal_proposition: BNS section 303 governs theft.

fact_pattern: A shop visitor surreptitiously conceals high-end perfume bottles in her bag and walks out without paying.

expected_legal_proposition: BNS section 303 governs theft.

fact_pattern: A person threatens a shopkeeper with burning down his commercial store unless he pays fifty thousand rupees every month.

expected_legal_proposition: BNS section 308 addresses extortion.

fact_pattern: A contractor is cornered by local criminals who demand an extortionate percentage on a public works tender under threat of physical assault.
legal_question: Which statutory section governs extortion under the BNS?

fact_pattern: A complaint alleging an offence punishable with imprisonment between 3 and 7 years is received. The police officer seeks to conduct a preliminary inquiry before registration.
